caption: The video showcases a silhouetted hand gripping the left edge of a flat circular disc with a central hole, held against a fully black background. Bright light produces a vivid rainbow diffraction pattern of concentric colored bands, with a white-yellow outer ring, cyan, and blue-purple inner zones. A tiny isolated blue speck of light sits at the right side of the frame throughout. The diffraction pattern continuously morphs as the disc is held; fairly uniform concentric rings give way to green, red, and orange hues at the top, then the colored light reorganizes into two separate rainbow arcs on the left and right sides with dark gaps above and below. The pattern re-forms into concentric rings again toward the last frames. The hand and the disc's overall position remain roughly constant, so the dominant visible change is the shifting color pattern on the disc surface rather than movement across the scene.
